description: Source code for handling log processing, including reading file tails, parsing JSON blocks, normalizing log lines, and summarizing log tail output. Also exports a function for selecting gateway presence info.

methods.name: readFileTailLines
methods.description: Reads the last few lines of a file asynchronously, trimming and filtering empty lines.

methods.name: summarizeLogTail
methods.description: Summarizes and deduplicates log lines, grouping similar error messages, and truncating output to a maximum number of lines.
